work: Qualified and created the separately operated, fixed Llandudno Cable Car after official catalogue searches found no matching Park or StandaloneAttraction. Integrated eight descriptions, exact location and opening information, source-backed cash-only and wheelchair conditions, two visually inspected exact licensed photos, eight public routes and Facebook publication.
qualification: Cable car between Happy Valley and Great Orme summit, separate from the Great Orme Tramway and the Cresta Toboggan Run. A durable scenic visitor attraction with its own ticketing; an independent StandaloneAttraction page is appropriate.
sourceLimitations: Visit Conwy shows a 2025 fare table that conflicts with its own FAQ; no current price was imported.
Opening is seasonal and wind dependent. No fixed schedule was imported.
The venue operator and equipment model were not independently confirmed and are left unset.
